newsitem.title: USA: Arch to post gain from pipeline unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Arch to post gain from pipeline unit sale.

text.p: Arch Petroleum Inc said on Monday that it will post a $6 million pre-tax gain from the sale of its 50 percent interest in Onyx Pipeline Co LC and its affiliates for $6 million.
The sale closed July 31, 1997 and is effective June 30, 1997.
In addition to the sales price, repayment was made to Arch of $1.8 million of advances for pipeline construction and other costs, Arch said in a statement.
Larry Kalas, president of Arch, said in a statement that the company will be able to reduce debt and focus on its oil and gas exploration and production operations.
